summary: Implemented the window title feature without running tests or repo code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod, which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning a bool, with the required docstring warnings. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on legacy consoles), test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only via the module's existing skip). Verification was by reading only; the tests and mypy have not been run.
